verdict.rationale: SolidJS documents that components run once (compiled) and use automatic dependency tracking so only code depending on changed state reruns—no virtual DOM diffing—directly matching the story, and independent reports confirm this yields fine-grained, high-performance surgical updates (fastest/smallest in benchmarks, 4x smaller/50x faster real-world rewrite). Missing for 10: no explicit first-party deep-dive on the compiler's DOM-update codegen internals, and one critique notes the reactive model can feel non-intuitive compared to alternatives.
